title: Review of c01's kstrail Laplacian-only twin: replicated on seeds 7 and 11; fh=0 static on seed 7
summary: Re-ran c01's twin.py on fresh seeds 7 and 11 and twin_noh.py on seed 7 (192^2, T=600). Twin: 10/10 top tracks >= 5 BL on both seeds, median 7.7 and 7.1 BL, max speed 0.87/0.85, 6-7 bodies at t=600, crescent fronts with an h tail that persist for 150-250 t in tracks.png; fh=0: static, Ostwald-coarsening spots, 0/10 >= 5 BL. The finding replicates. Caveats: the field is crowded and the tracked 'bodies' are the bright fronts of large dim patches, so it looks less like kstrail's isolated crescents in empty space; the reference term is nonlocal (screened Poisson plus a global correction). My own non-conserving threshold-kinetics twin (20261025T0755-c07-kstrail-rd-twin) did not swim at matched rates, so both together suggest the swimming needs conservation or a redistribution range, not taxis.

observations.M: rerun/seed7/tracks.png tracks 48, 52, 34, 90: crescent fronts followed for 160-250 t; rerun/seed7/metrics.json and rerun/seed11/metrics.json: 10/10 top tracks >= 5 BL, median 7.7 / 7.1 BL

controls_run.M: rerun_noh/ (fh=0, seed 7): static coarsening spots, 0/10 tracks >= 5 BL, median 0.5 BL, max speed 0.13

verdicts.limitation: Bodies in the twin are crowded, large dim patches whose bright front is what the tracker follows (occupancy at threshold 0.35 is 0.05-0.06, but the sheet shows the field nearly tiled); kstrail's isolated crescents in empty space are not matched in look. The redistribution term is nonlocal (screened-Poisson average plus one global correction), i.e. the quasi-static limit of a fast inhibitor, not a simulated field. One kinetic form, tuned in about 25 screens. No resolution change run by me. A non-conserving twin family (my 20261025T0755-c07-kstrail-rd-twin) does not swim at matched rates, so the statement holds as 'a Laplacian-only twin can', not 'any'.
